What We Design

Eight connected layers help a mall feel easy to navigate, comfortable to stay in and ready for every tenant.

01

Atrium & Common Area Design

Arrival spaces, shared seating and social points planned as the heart of the mall.

02

Retail Corridor Planning

Clear sightlines and comfortable widths guide people past every shopfront.

03

Food Court Design

Seating, vendor fronts and service flow are coordinated for busy periods.

04

Entrance & Facade Design

A strong first impression leads visitors naturally into the building.

05

Tenant Mix Zoning

Retail categories and anchors are placed to support movement and discovery.

06

Wayfinding & Signage

Directories and directional signs make every destination easier to find.

07

Lighting & Ambience

Daylight, ambient and feature lighting create comfort and visual rhythm.

08

Safety & Circulation Planning

Routes, exits and vertical movement are resolved around safe daily flow.

01 / 08

Our Design Process

Five clear stages turn the commercial brief into an approved mall design package.

01

Consultation & Requirements

We define the visitor profile, tenant needs, zones, budget and programme.

02

Site Measurement

We record levels, circulation, services, access and existing conditions.

03

Concept & Layout Design

Atriums, corridors, retail zones and visitor flow are tested together.

04

Material & Furniture Selection

Durable finishes, lighting and shared furniture are coordinated for daily use.

05

Final Design Package & 3D Visualization

Approved 3D views and drawings prepare each zone for pricing and execution.

Pricing

The initial consultation and site survey are free. We provide a fixed quote once the built-up area, tenant scope and 3D package are clear.
